name: Carina
signatureAbility:
Contest of Champions
Carina gains +[115.48 - 305.56] Critical Rating for each of the following #Tags on the Opponent: #Avengers, #Hydra, #Spider-Verse Heroes, #Sinister Six, #Symbiote, #X-Men, #Brotherhood of Mutants, #Fantastic Four, #Guardians of the Galaxy, #Defenders, #Robot.
Overstacking Carina's Persistent ISO-8 Shards inflicts an indefinite 10% Suppression Passive. Max stacks: [1 - 8] (rounded down).

abilitySections.title: Elder Physiology - Always Active
content: In tune with the latent powers of The Contest, Carina has a Fractured Power Bar.

As an Elder of the Universe, Carina possesses a near immortal body. This causes her to gain a Regeneration Buff every time she loses 20% of her Max Health, healing 10% of Max Health over 10 seconds. Each Health threshold only triggers once per fight.
Carina starts each fight with a 3% Safeguard Buff for 3 seconds that starts paused until she's struck, and is removed if the Opponent activates a Special Attack 3.

abilitySections.title: Growing Power
content: Carina's Power Gain Buffs grant 0.3% of Max Power over 5 seconds. They expire one at a time and are refreshed when gaining a new one. Max stacks: 20.
Carina's first landed Light Attack in a combo grants her 2 Power Gain Buffs. When she whiffs a Basic Attack or attacks the Opponent during their Special Attack, she gains 1 Power Gain Buff.

abilitySections.title: Growing Beyond
content: Overstacking Carina's Power Gains grants stackable indefinite Unblockable Buffs. Striking the Opponent consumes one of these Unblockables to inflict a [305.56] Armor Break Debuff for 2 seconds.
At 10+ Unblockable Buffs, activating a Special Attack grants Carina a non-stacking +[2,542] Myriad Buff for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Soul of The Contest - Max: 8
content: The first time in each fight Carina gains her Myriad Buff, she gains a Persistent ISO-8 Shard. She also gains a Shard each time the Opponent reaches 1% Health.
Each Persistent ISO-8 Shard increases the base potency and duration of Carina's personal Debuffs by 12.5% for the rest of the Quest.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Elder Storm
content: On activation, Carina gains 3 Amplify Buffs. One has 200% potency and lasts 3 seconds, one has 100% potency and lasts 6 seconds, and one has 50% potency and lasts 12 seconds.
Each of the four hits grant Carina 3 personal Power Gain Buffs.
This Special Attack has a 0.5 second cooldown.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Empyrean Glare
content: The final 4 hits each inflict a [12,710] Corrosion Debuff for 40 seconds. Max stacks: 8. As a Defender, these scale with Base Attack only.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Battlerealm Seraph
content: Immediately on activation, Carina gains 10 personal Power Gain Buffs and regains her Safeguard Buff if it is not active.
Carina gains stackable True Damage, Zeal, and Instinct Buffs, 10% Energize, Rejuvenate, and Aptitude Buffs, and +[687.5] Armor Up and Precision Buffs, all for 12 seconds.
